notes: A MONTH-END CHECK THAT COULD NOT BE READ NO LONGER COUNTS AS A CHECK THAT PASSED. The month-end close runs through a short checklist before you sign the month off: is anything dated in the month still unposted, and is every bank account reconciled. Each of those is a question put to your books. If one of them could not be answered — the question failed rather than came back empty — the blank answer was being read as good news: "nothing left unposted", "no bank accounts to reconcile", said over bank accounts that plainly exist. Both are checks that must be green before a clean sign-off, so the checklist turned green, the sign-off went ahead without a warning, and that green result was written into the month-end record — the one you or an auditor open months later, long after anyone would remember that anything went wrong. A check whose question failed now says exactly that, cannot be ticked off, and the page names which one failed. The same rule now covers the question "has this month already been signed off": when that could not be answered, a closed month looked open, which invited a second sign-off on top of the first. ABOUT THE PREVIOUS RELEASE'S NOTES. Version 0.6.64 said that all thirty-three findings from its review were fixed. That was not correct, and this is the one that was missed: it was raised, it was confirmed twice, and then it was left out because the closing summary counted batches of work instead of counting the findings themselves. It was found by going back through the finished release screen by screen rather than by re-reading the summary. Nothing else from that review was affected — the other thirty-two were checked again and are in place. The review record now closes by listing every finding number and proving none is unaccounted for, which is how this should have been done the first time. There are no data changes in this release. Take a backup before installing, as always, and install over the top; your books are untouched.
